name: security-search-index-entitlements-review
intent: Search index/query authorization and stale document entitlements
artifacts: Ingestion identity/ACL fields, query filter construction, snippets/highlights and delete/revocation propagation.
trace: Trace original document authority through index metadata into every returned hit/snippet/facet. Check whether caller-writable filters or stale ACLs substitute for current permission.
experiment: Use two owned synthetic documents and users; compare permitted search with a restricted document marker before/after entitlement removal.
disproof: A public title or aggregate count is not necessarily private content; establish the declared confidentiality of the observed signal.
repair: Bind index/query output to current entitlement and verify snippets, exports, facets and deletion paths relevant to the finding.
branch_decisions: Map source object permissions into indexed fields, query filters and post-fetch checks, including snippets, facets and suggestions. A stale index entry is not necessarily readable if a final entitlement check rejects it. Use a synthetic permission change and record the effective propagation contract; classify count/snippet leakage separately from full content disclosure.
